discarded_attempt.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: tiny painted SILVER Victoria 3 ship designer equipment icon on transparent background.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET; its geometry is WRONG and must not be copied unchanged. Keep the silver-blue embossed brushwork, raised rectangular wooden quarterdeck, small crate, upright cask, upper rear railing and compact glyph concept. Reconstruct the lower deck and supports correctly.

Specific defect: the left/front lower support has an incorrectly shortened leg. The right/front leg is much longer. Their feet form an excessively steep diagonal that is NOT parallel to the upper front beam. This must visibly change. Extend the LEFT FRONT support DOWNWARD substantially (approximately 90-100 pixels at the input size); reshape the lower platform beneath it accordingly. Do not merely restyle the same drawing.

Mandatory geometric construction: use orthographic isometric projection. Draw the rectangular raised deck with front edge sloping down to the right. Duplicate that SAME rectangle straight DOWN by one constant screen-space vertical offset to define the four foot locations on the lower deck. Join corresponding corners with vertical support columns of IDENTICAL projected height. In particular, if the two visible front post attachment centers are A and B and the post height is H, their foot centers must be A+(0,H) and B+(0,H). Therefore the line joining their feet must be EXACTLY PARALLEL to the line joining their top attachment points and the upper front beam. All four supports have the same drop from upper deck to floor. No short left leg, no floor changing height under one pillar. Both visible front foot contacts unobscured so the alignment can be judged. The lower deck can extend forward slightly for the crate, but its surface remains one single flat plane. Crate and barrel rest on that plane, never floating or cutting through columns. Avoid a solid back wall; show open space below upper deck.

Keep simple broad shapes, cool SILVER palette only, thin dark edge, restrained bevel highlights, no extra props, no ship hull or full scene, no text, no annotation marks or construction lines in final icon. This is a game icon readable at 32px, not a realistic scene or detailed blueprint. Preserve genuinely transparent background and transparent gaps, generous margins, no glow, aura, haze, cast backdrop shadow or black background. Priority is the EQUAL SUPPORT HEIGHT and PARALLEL FRONT FOOT LINE, even if the lower platform and crate position must change.
